description: Visually compare two web pages and return a diff percentage plus a highlighted diff image. Pass a before and an after URL for an ad-hoc diff, or an after URL with a project and page_name to diff against the stored project baseline.

after.description: URL of the page after the change.

before.description: URL of the page before the change.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the full page instead of the viewport.

ignore_selectors.description: CSS selectors for elements to ignore in the comparison.

page_name.description: Name of the page with a stored baseline.

name: snapdiff_compare_pages
